title: Mapped network drives
whyItMatters: Saved drive mappings disclose server and share names, and may indicate stored credentials for those shares.
source: Per-user mapped drives are stored under HKCU\Network (Microsoft Learn: net use / Windows network connections registry)
notes: One subkey per mapped drive letter. Only key and value counts are reported; connection strings and any saved credentials are not read.

steps: Open File Explorer and select This PC.
Right-click each mapped drive and select Disconnect.
Remove any saved credentials for those servers in Credential Manager.
cleanup.risk: The drive mappings and any saved credentials for those shares are removed from this account. Shared files on the server are untouched.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Map a network drive in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/map-a-network-drive-in-windows-29ce55d1-34e3-a7e2-4801-131475f9557d
